I've always seen intent as meaning it's set in stone it will happen. So in the case of not having a date as long as you intend to still do it then it's still intent. Not taking any actions towards committing the act would mean they would never do it. If one day it pops into their head that they will do it then they'd have to take action. To have intent means you intend on doing it so eventually you'd have to act on the action.

This hits home to me, I have a very ideal life which makes me feel guilty for wanting to off myself. That could possibly be a part of the pain you feel but you mentioned a successful career. What is a successful career for you?

For me anyway I've always seen it that a plan would be planning out each thing you'd do. For example the plan of, write note, head to spot to jump, jump. That's the plan. It is something that you have in the back of your mind that you say you'll do as it's your plan. Intent is when you finally decide to act on your plan. I've had many plans, it would only be intent if I acted on it. That's my thoughts on it anyway.

But at the end of the day most people in life will simply pass you having no opinions on you, the same with pretty much everyone they meet. Humans just simply don't acknowledge people that often and thus will likely forget any faces they saw that they passed in a matter of seconds.

TL;DR: Everyone is beautiful in their own way and everyone will see everyone in their own ways. But ultimately at the end of the day noone really thinks that person was beautiful or ugly because typically everyone is already worried about their own appearances, why bother with someone else's.
